title: Replace an aquatic licence certificate
summary: Find out how to order a replacement aquatic licence certificate if your original certificate is lost, damaged, or destroyed.
intro:
Aquatic licences are for temporary events, and you need to have applied for your licence at least 6 weeks before the event or activity starts – even earlier for more complex events or activities.

If your aquatic licence certificate is lost, damaged or destroyed, you'll need to order a replacement at a service centre, or by mail.
who_can_apply: The certificate is needed if it is lost, damaged, or destroyed.
what_you_need: Proof of identity (for representatives of an organisation).
A written request for a replacement certificate or the Application for Replacement Products form.
For organisations, written authority on company letterhead with the representative's proof of identity.

how_to_steps.text: Download, print and complete the Application for Maritime Replacement Products – PDF (if applicable).
Make sure that you have all the required documentation and information.
Visit a service centre and submit the application in person, or mail your application to the details on the form.

faqs.q: How far in advance must I apply for an aquatic licence?
faqs.a: Aquatic licences are for temporary events, and you must apply for your licence at least 6 weeks before the event or activity starts. This timeframe is even earlier for more complex events or activities.

faqs.q: How can I get a replacement aquatic licence certificate?
faqs.a: You can order a replacement at a service centre or by mail.
